q.description: String to search for. Has to be [URL-encoded](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Percent-encoding).

sources.description:

BNC uses universal identifiers (UUIDs) for assets and markets. Each index type will have a UUID which identifies the constituent type used to build the index:

| Index Type | Index Id  | Output |
| -----------|:--------

timestamp.description: Retrieve all daily OHLCV records up to the timestamp provided. All dates are stored in UTC. Timestamp strings should be in the form  YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

Otherwise, since records are in reverse data order, use in conjunction with timestamp to make selections back in time.

startAfter.description: UUID. Retrieve OHLCV for the indexId or indexType required, starting after this particular record id. Every record in the dataset has a universal identifier (UUID). This parameter provides for pagination through large selections since every response includes a nextId that can be used here.

indexType.description: Restrict the OHLCV results to the index type. Either MWA or GWA.

indexId.description:
Retrieve all the OHLCV values for a particular asset or market by its id. The index id is a universal identifier (UUID) that will differ based on the index type.

| Index Type | Index Id  |
| -----------|:---------:|
| MWA        |Market Id  |
| GWA        |Asset Id   |

Highly customizable search through our database of news only on the next specific keywords:

q.description:

media.description:
Adds to the output of the call two more variables: `media` and `media_content`

Media - the main image published with an article 

media_content  - a comma-separated string of all images used in an article

lang.description:
Specifies the language of the search.  Allowed values are:
 `af`, `ar`, `bg`, `bn`, `ca`, `cs`, `cy`, `da`, `de`, `el`, `en`, `es`, `et`, `fa`, `fi`, `fr`, `gu`, `he`,
`hi`, `hr`, `hu`, `id`, `it`, `ja`, `kn`, `ko`, `lt`, `lv`, `mk`, `ml`, `mr`, `ne`, `nl`, `no`, `pa`, `pl`,
`pt`, `ro`, `ru`, `sk`,

from.description:
From which point in time to start the search. No specific format is required. 
E.g. (`2020/05/01`, `2020-05-01` ,`2020-05-01 12:54:14`, `2020-05-01 4:15am`, `yesterday 2:02 am`, `2020/05/01 12:55 EST`) .
The default timezone is UTC. **Defaults to one week ago at midnight UTC.**

page.description: The number of the page. Use it to scroll through the results. Defaults to 1

search_in.description: By default, we search what you specified in `q` in both `title` and `summary` of the article. However, you can limit this to either `title` or `summary`

to.description: Until which point in time to search for. The default timezone is UTC

topic.description:
The topic to which you want to restrict the articles of your choice. This parameter is [experimental]. Accepted values are `news`, `sport`, `tech`, `world`, `finance`, `politics`, `business`, `economics`, `entertainment`
`news` usually means a general news feed (main headlines of a website).
> Impor

not_sources.description:
One or more sources to be excluded from the search. 
> Comma separated string, for example `not_sources=nytimes.com,cnn.com,wsj.com`

to_rank.description: Upper boundary of the rank of news website to filter by

from_rank.description: Lowest boundary of the rank of news website to filter by. **Important**: lower rank means that a source is more popular

sort_by.description:
- `relevancy` — the most relevant results first, 
- `date` — the most recently published results first, 
- `rank` — the results from the highest-ranked sources first

page_size.description: How many articles to return per page. Defaults to 50, max is 100

sources.description:
One or more news resources to filter your search. It should be the normal form of the URL, for example, **[nytimes.com](http://nytimes.com/)**, **[theguardian.com](http://theguardian.com/)**
> Comma separated string, for example `sources=nytimes.com,cnn.com,wsj.com`

country.description: The country to which you want to narrow your search. This parameter is [experimental]. We advise you to use it in conjunction with the `lang` parameter. Accepts any [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) codes

ranked_only.description: Limit the search only for the sources which are in top 1 million online websites. Defaults to `True` (`False` if you want to turn it off). Unranked sources are assigned a rank that equals to `999999`

Fast Routing.Get Route.description: Get a driving route for cars (with turn-by-turn directions) by submitting (at least) a start- and endpoint.

continue_straight.description: Forces the route to keep going straight at waypoints constraining uturns there even if it would be faster. Default is `default`, which translates to `true`.

waypoints.description: Example: `{index};{index};{index}`. Treats input coordinates indicated by given indices as waypoints in returned Match object. Default is to treat all input coordinates as waypoints.

alternatives.description: Show alternative routes? Either `true`, `false` (default) or a number [1,..,n] (of alternative routes to show if available).

annotations.description: Either `true` , `false` (default), `nodes` , `distance` , `duration` , `datasources` , `weight` , `speed`. Defines if additional data for each coordinate should be returned.

geometries.description: Either `polyline` (default), `polyline6` or `geojson`. Returned route geometry format (influences overview and per step).

exclude.description: Example: `{class}`. Type of step to be avoided on route. Can be either `motorway`, `ferry` or `toll`.

bearings.description: Value: `{bearing};{bearing}[;{bearing} ...]`. Limits the search to segments with given bearing in degrees towards true north in clockwise direction for each waypoint defined in coordinates.

skip_waypoints.description: Default is `false`. Removes waypoints from the response. Waypoints are still calculated, but not serialized. Could be useful in case you are interested in some other part of response and do not want to transfer waste data.

snapping.description: `Default` snapping avoids is_startpoint edges, `any` will snap to any edge in the graph.

approaches.description: Value: `{approach};{approach}[;{approach} ...]`. Keep waypoints on curb side for each waypoint defined in coordinates path paramter.

overview.description: Add overview geometry either `full` or  `simplified` according to highest zoom level it could be displayed on a map, or not at all (`false`). Default is `simplified`.

radiuses.description: Values: `{radius};{radius}[;{radius} ...]`. Limits the search to given radius in meters. Set one radius for each waypoint defined in coordinates path parameter.

steps.description: Get turn-by-turn direction information. Default is `false`.

end_date.description: The end date of the recalled drug list, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

manufacturer.description: The name of the manufacturer of the recalled drug. Leave blank to retrieve all manufacturers.

delete_recall.description: Delete a recall from the system.

recall_id.description: The ID of the recall to be deleted.

submit_medical_leave_request.description: Submit a medical leave request for an employee. It has four input parameters: 'employee_id', 'start_date', 'end_date', and 'reason'. 'employee_id' is the unique identifier for the employee, 'start_date' and 'end_date' is the date range for the medical leave, and 'reason' is the reason for the leave request.

employee_id.description: The unique identifier for the employee.

start_date.description: The start date of the medical leave. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

end_date.description: The end date of the medical leave. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

reason.description: The reason for the medical leave.

approve_medical_leave_request.description: Approve a medical leave request for an employee. It has three input parameters: 'leave_request_id', 'approver_id', and 'approval_date'. 'leave_request_id' is the identifier for the leave request, 'approver_id' is the unique identifier for the approver, and 'approval_date' is the date of approval.

leave_request_id.description: The unique identifier for the leave request.

approver_id.description: The unique identifier for the approver.

approval_date.description: The date of approval. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

get_medication_reminder.description: Get a reminder for the patient to take their medication.

patient_id.description: The unique identifier of the patient who the reminder is for.

reminder_time.description: The date and time the reminder should be sent. Format: yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss

AppealSubmission.description: Submit an appeal for denied health insurance claim. This API requires three parameters: 'policy_holder_name', 'policy_number' and 'appeal_reason'. 'policy_holder_name' refers to the name of the policy holder whose claim has been denied, 'policy_number' refers to the policy number, and 'appeal_reason' specifies the reason why the claim should be approved.

policy_holder_name.description: Name of the policy holder who wants to submit an appeal.

policy_number.description: Policy number which the appeal is being made against.

AppealStatusCheck.description: Check the status of a submitted appeal. This API has one parameter: 'appeal_id', which refers to the ID of the submitted appeal you want to check.

appeal_id.description: ID for the submitted appeal you want to check.

AppealDecision.description: Submit a decision regarding the appeal for denied health insurance claim. This API has three parameters: 'appeal_id', 'appeal_decision' and 'additional_details'. 'appeal_id' refers to the ID of the appeal, 'appeal_decision' specifies whether the appeal has been approved or denied, and 'additional_details' provides any additional remarks regarding the decision.

appeal_decision.description: Decision regarding the appeal. Can be either 'approved' or 'denied'.

CheckPrescription.description: API that checks whether the prescription is still valid, and returns the prescription status and medication information. It has one input parameter, 'prescription_code', which is a string representing the prescription code obtained from the user.

prescription_code.description: The code of the prescription to check for validity.

RenewPrescription.description: API that allows the user to request a prescription renewal. It has two input parameters, 'prescription_code' and 'reason', which are strings representing the prescription code and the reason for the renewal, respectively.

prescription_code.description: The code of the prescription to request renewal for.

reason.description: The reason for requesting the renewal of the prescription.

GetPrescriptionHistory.description: API that retrieves the user's prescription history. It has one input parameter, 'user_id', which is a string representing the user's ID.

user_id.description: The ID of the user whose prescription history is to be retrieved.

license_query.description: Query license information by healthcare provider's name and license number

name.description: Healthcare provider's name

license_number.description: License number of the healthcare provider

appointment_history.description: Query appointment history for a healthcare provider

name.description: Healthcare provider's name

start_date.description: Start date of the search in the format yyyy-mm-dd

end_date.description: End date of the search in the format yyyy-mm-dd

insurance_verification.description: Verify patient insurance eligibility and coverage for a healthcare provider

patient_name.description: Name of the patient

service_date.description: Date of service in the format yyyy-mm-dd

service_code.description: Code for the service being provided

check_credential.description: Check if a healthcare provider has the necessary credentials and is licensed to practice.

provider_name.description: The name of the healthcare provider to be checked.

license_number.description: The license number of the healthcare provider to be checked.

provider_type.description: The type of healthcare provider to be checked.

GetDischargePlan.description: Retrieve the discharge plan for a patient's illness, containing information such as medications, follow-up appointments, and dietary recommendations.

patient_id.description: The unique identifier for the patient.

CreateMedicationReminder.description: Creates a medication reminder for a patient's prescribed medication.

patient_id.description: The unique identifier for the patient.

medication_name.description: The name of the medication the reminder is for.

medication_dosage.description: The dosage of the medication the reminder is for.

reminder_time.description: The time the medication reminder should be sent, in the format HH:MM.

GetHospitalReviews.description: Retrieves a list of patient reviews for a specific hospital.

hospital_name.description: The name of the hospital to retrieve reviews for.

book_class_slot.description: Book a slot for a selected class.

class_id.description: The ID of the class whose slot is being booked.

name.description: The name of the person booking the slot.

email.description: The email address of the person booking the slot.

phone.description: The phone number of the person booking the slot.

cancel_class_slot.description: Cancel the booked slot for a selected class.

class_id.description: The ID of the class whose slot is being cancelled.

email.description: The email address of the person who booked the slot.

update_medication_date.description: Update the expiration date of a medication of a patient.

patient_id.description: The ID of the patient whose medication expiration date needs to be updated.

medication_name.description: The name of the medication.

new_expiration_date.description: The new expiration date of the medication. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. For example: 2022-05-30.

CreateAllergyRecord.description: Create allergy record API, which contains three parameters: 'patient_id', 'allergen_name' and 'reaction_description'. The 'patient_id' parameter refers to the unique ID of the patient whose allergy record needs to be created, 'allergen_name' is the name of the allergen that caused the reaction, and 'reaction_description' describes the type of allergic reaction experienced by the patient.

patient_id.description: The unique ID of the patient whose allergy record needs to be created.

allergen_name.description: The name of the allergen that caused the reaction.

reaction_description.description: Describes the type of allergic reaction experienced by the patient.

GetPatientAllergyRecords.description: Query allergy records of a patient API, which contains one parameter: 'patient_id'. The 'patient_id' parameter refers to the unique ID of the patient whose allergy records need to be queried.

patient_id.description: The unique ID of the patient whose allergy records need to be queried.

UpdateAllergyRecord.description: Update an existing allergy record API, which contains four parameters: 'record_id', 'patient_id', 'allergen_name' and 'reaction_description'. The 'record_id' parameter refers to the unique ID of the allergy record that needs to be updated, 'patient_id' is the unique ID of the patient whose allergy record needs to be updated, 'allergen_name' is the name of the allergen that caused the reaction, and 'reaction_description' describes the type of allergic reaction experienced by the patient.

record_id.description: The unique ID of the allergy record that needs to be updated.

patient_id.description: The unique ID of the patient whose allergy record needs to be updated.

allergen_name.description: The name of the allergen that caused the reaction.

reaction_description.description: Describes the type of allergic reaction experienced by the patient.

search_claim_status.description: Search for the status of a claim based on a claim ID or policy number, and status information is returned.

search_text.description: The claim ID or policy number that needs to be searched.

check_claim_eligibility.description: Check the eligibility of a claim based on the policy number and the amount of the requested claim.

policy_number.description: The policy number associated with the claim.

requested_amount.description: The amount requested for the claim.

get_sleep_stats.description: Get the user's sleep statistics for a specified time period.

user_id.description: Unique identifier of the user whose sleep statistics will be retrieved.

start_date.description: Start date of the time period to retrieve sleep statistics.

end_date.description: End date of the time period to retrieve sleep statistics.

search_resources.description: Search mental health resources API, used to obtain a list of mental health resources based on user's search query. It contains one input parameter, search_query, which contains the user's search query

feedback_survey.description: A survey API that collects user feedback on mental health resources. Contains six input parameters, all of which are required: 'resource_name', 'resource_type', 'rating', 'comments', 'age_group', 'gender'

resource_name.description: The name of the mental health resource that the user is providing feedback on

resource_type.description: The type of mental health resource that the user is providing feedback on

rating.description: The user's rating of the mental health resource, ranging from 1-5

comments.description: The user's comments on the mental health resource

gender.description: The user's gender

get_forum_posts.description: Get forum posts API, used to obtain the latest forum posts related to mental health. It contains one input parameter, 'max_results', which specifies the maximum number of posts to return

max_results.description: The maximum number of posts to return

Search_Disease.description: API for searching for disease information by name. The API has one input parameter, 'disease_name', which is a string that specifies the name of the disease that the user wants to search.

disease_name.description: The name of the disease that the user wants to search.

Get_Health_Tips.description: Get tips related to a specific health issue. The API has one input parameter, 'health_issue', which is a string that specifies the health issue for which the user wants to get tips.

health_issue.description: The name of the health issue for which the user wants to get tips.

Book_Doctor_Appointment.description: Book an appointment with a doctor. The API has three input parameters: 'patient_name', 'doctor_name' and 'appointment_date'. The 'patient_name' parameter refers to the name of the patient who wants to book the appointment, 'doctor_name' refers to the name of the doctor with whom the appointment is to be booked, and 'appointment_date' specifies the date on which the appointment is to be booked.

patient_name.description: The name of the patient who wants to book the appointment.

doctor_name.description: The name of the doctor with whom the appointment is to be booked.

appointment_date.description: Date on which the appointment is to be booked. Format: yyyy-mm-dd. For example: 2021-08-20

SearchSymptoms.description: This API is used to search for related medical symptoms based on user input. A 'query' parameter is required as input, which is a string that represents the user's query.

query.description: The user's query for related medical symptoms.

RecordSymptom.description: This API is used to record a specific medical symptom for a user. 'symptom_name' and 'severity' parameters are required as input, which represent the name of the medical symptom and its severity respectively.

symptom_name.description: Name of the medical symptom to be recorded.

severity.description: Severity of the medical symptom, expressed as an integer from 1 to 10.

SymptomAnalysis.description: This API is used to analyze the recorded medical symptoms of a user over a period of time. 'start_date' and 'end_date' parameters are required as input, which represent the start and end dates for analyzing the medical symptoms.

start_date.description: Start date for analyzing the medical symptoms. Format: %Y-%m-%d. For example: 2022-01-01

end_date.description: End date for analyzing the medical symptoms. Format: %Y-%m-%d. For example: 2022-01-31

get_rental_history.description: Get the rental history for a user.

user_id.description: The ID of the user.

GetTherapistList.description: Get a list of available therapists for a telehealth psychiatry consultation service. It has one input parameter, 'location', which is a character that indicates the location of the user.

location.description: The location of the user.

GetAppointmentHistory.description: Get the history of appointments for a user who has used the telehealth psychiatry consultation service. It has one input parameter, 'user_id', which is a character that identifies the user.

user_id.description: ID of the user.

get_doctor_reviews.description: Retrieve reviews of a specific doctor. Two parameters are required: 'doctor_name' and 'hospital_name'.

doctor_name.description: The name of the doctor to retrieve reviews for.

hospital_name.description: The hospital where the doctor works.

get_treatment_options.description: Retrieve treatment options for a specific illness. One parameter is required: 'illness_name'.

illness_name.description: The name of the illness to retrieve treatment options for.

CreateSession.description: Create a new virtual psychology counseling session. It has two input parameters, 'patient_name' and 'counselor_name', which are strings pointing to the names of the patient and counselor, respectively.

patient_name.description: The name of the patient who requires virtual counseling.

counselor_name.description: The name of the counselor who will conduct the virtual counseling.

SessionFeedback.description: Provide feedback for a psychology counseling session.

session_id.description: The unique identifier for the session that feedback is being provided for.

rating.description: The rating given by the user for the session on a scale of 1-5.

feedback_text.description: Additional feedback provided by the user for the session.

ListSessions.description: Retrieve a list of virtual psychology counseling sessions for a specific patient or counselor. It has one input parameter, 'user_type', which is a string indicating whether the request is being made for a 'patient' or a 'counselor'. If 'patient', an additional parameter 'patient_name' is required, and if 'counselor', 'counselor_name' is required.

user_type.description: Whether the request is for a 'patient' or a 'counselor'.

patient_name.description: Name of the patient user, required if 'user_type' is 'patient'.

counselor_name.description: Name of the counselor user, required if 'user_type' is 'counselor'.

get_insurance_plan_details.description: API to retrieve details about a specific health insurance plan.

plan_name.description: The name of the insurance plan to retrieve details for.

Get_Healthcare_Providers_Reviews.description: Get all reviews for a healthcare provider.

find_providers.description: Retrieve a list of healthcare providers that match the provided search criteria, such as their specialty, location, or name.

specialty.description: The specialty of the healthcare provider to search for.

location.description: The location of the healthcare provider to search for.

name.description: The name of the healthcare provider to search for.

claim_submission.description: Submit a health insurance claim for reimbursement. Requires policy information, diagnosis codes, treatment dates, and claim amount.

policyNumber.description: Policy number of the insured person.

diagnosisCodes.description: List of diagnosis codes related to the claim.

treatmentDates.description: List of treatment dates related to the claim, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

claimAmount.description: Amount of the insurance claim being submitted.

get_provider_directory.description: Lookup provider directory information based on specialty and location.

specialty.description: Specialty of the provider, such as neurology or pediatrics.

zipCode.description: 5-digit zip code of the provider's location.

disposal_methods.description: This API provides information on various methods used for disposal of medications. It has one input parameter, 'medication_name', which is a character that points to the name of the medication for which the user needs disposal method information.

medication_name.description: Name of the medication for which the user needs the disposal method information.

medication_check.description: Check if the medication can be disposed of in household trash or not. It has two input parameters, 'medication_name' and 'medication_type'. The 'medication_name' parameter refers to the name of the medication to be disposed of and 'medication_type' specifies if it is a controlled substance or a non-controlled substance.

medication_name.description: Name of the medication to be disposed of.

medication_type.description: Type of medication whether it is a controlled substance or a non-controlled substance.

disposal_sites.description: Check for nearby medication disposal sites using user's location coordinates. It has two input parameters, 'latitude' and 'longitude'. The 'latitude' parameter refers to the user's current location latitude and 'longitude' refers to the user's current location longitude.

latitude.description: User's current location latitude.

longitude.description: User's current location longitude.

request_medical_bill_payment_assistance.description: This API helps patients apply for medical bill payment assistance.

patient_id.description: The ID of the patient applying for assistance.

hospital_name.description: The name of the hospital where the patient has received treatment.

total_bill_amount.description: The total amount of the medical bill.

insurance_coverage_amount.description: The amount covered by the insurance company.

get_payment_options.description: This API returns a list of available payment options for medical bills.

hospital_name.description: Name of the hospital where the bill is to be paid.

assistance_approved.description: Whether assistance has been approved for the medical bill. true if approved, false if not approved.

buy_alternative_medicine.description: This API allows the user to purchase alternative medicine. It has two input parameters, 'medicine_name' and 'qty'. The 'medicine_name' parameter refers to the name of the medicine to be purchased, and 'qty' specifies the quantity of medicine desired by the user to purchase.

medicine_name.description: Name of the alternative medicine to purchase

qty.description: Quantity of the alternative medicine to purchase

list_alternative_medicine.description: This API lists all available alternative medicine in the store. It has no input parameter.

AddVolunteer.description: Allows a user to add themselves as a medical research volunteer with the specified information.

FullName.description: The full name of the volunteer.

Email.description: The email address of the volunteer.

Phone.description: The phone number of the volunteer.

ExistingConditions.description: A list of existing medical conditions the volunteer has.

Medications.description: A list of medications the volunteer is currently taking.

GetStudies.description: Returns a list of available medical research studies that a volunteer can participate in.

MedicalCondition.description: Filters the studies returned based on the medical condition being studied.

MinimumAge.description: Filters the studies returned based on the minimum age of the volunteer needed to be eligible for the study.

MaximumAge.description: Filters the studies returned based on the maximum age of the volunteer needed to be eligible for the study.

EnrollVolunteer.description: Enrolls a volunteer in a medical research study.

VolunteerID.description: The ID assigned to the volunteer upon registration.

StudyName.description: The name of the medical research study to enroll in.

submit_medical_leave.description: This API allows the employee to submit a medical leave request

employeeName.description: The name of the employee submitting the leave request

startDate.description: The start date of the leave request. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

endDate.description: The end date of the leave request. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

reason.description: The reason for the medical leave request

doctorNote.description: The doctor's note for the medical leave request

approve_medical_leave.description: This API allows the manager to approve a medical leave request

employeeName.description: The name of the employee who submitted the leave request

startDate.description: The start date of the leave request. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

endDate.description: The end date of the leave request. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

get_medical_leave_info.description: This API allows the employee to retrieve information about their medical leave requests

GetDoctorList.description: This API retrieves a list of doctors based on their specialty and location. It has two input parameters, 'specialty' and 'location', which are strings that specify the desired specialty and location, respectively.

specialty.description: The desired specialty of the doctors.

location.description: The location of the doctors in terms of city, state, or zip code.

ScheduleAppointment.description: This API schedules an appointment between a patient and a doctor. It has three input parameters: 'patient_name', 'doctor_name', and 'appointment_time'. The 'patient_name' parameter is a string that specifies the name of the patient, 'doctor_name' is a string that specifies the name of the doctor, and 'appointment_time' is a string that specifies the desired date and time of the appointment.

patient_name.description: The name of the patient scheduling the appointment.

doctor_name.description: The name of the doctor with whom the patient is scheduling the appointment.

appointment_time.description: The date and time of the desired appointment in the format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

GetConsultationHistory.description: This API retrieves a list of previous consultations a patient has had with a specific doctor. It has two input parameters: 'patient_name' and 'doctor_name', which are strings that specify the name of the patient and the doctor, respectively.

patient_name.description: The name of the patient whose consultation history is being retrieved.

doctor_name.description: The name of the doctor whose consultation history is being retrieved.

search_groups.description: API for searching mental health support groups with filters. The API requires the following parameters: 'search_query' (required) - a text-based query to match the name of the group, 'location' (optional) - a location to limit the search to a particular geographical area, 'group_type' (optional) - type of support group, e.g. depression, stress, anxiety.

search_query.description: Search query to match the name of the mental health support group

location.description: Location of where the support group should be searched. If not provided, search will be performed globally

group_type.description: Type of support group, e.g. depression, stress, anxiety

join_group.description: API for joining a mental health support group by providing the user's personal information and group details. The API requires the following parameters: 'user_name' (required) - name of the user joining the group, 'group_name' (required) - name of the support group the user wants to join, 'group_type' (required) - type of support group, e.g. depression, stress, anxiety.

user_name.description: Name of the user joining the support group

group_name.description: Name of the support group the user wants to join

group_type.description: Type of support group, e.g. depression, stress, anxiety

leave_group.description: API for leaving a mental health support group. User provides the name of the support group they want to leave and their personal information. The API requires the following parameters: 'user_name' (required) - name of the user leaving the group, 'group_name' (required) - name of the support group the user wants to leave, 'group_type' (required) - type of support group, e.g. depression, stress, anxiety.

user_name.description: Name of the user leaving the support group

group_name.description: Name of the support group the user wants to leave

group_type.description: Type of support group, e.g. depression, stress, anxiety
